en.note_DR: Doubly reinforced: the tension steel is past the maximum of the singly reinforced section (A_s,max) and complies because the compression steel on the opposite face lifts that limit (A_s,max,eff).
en.note_9.6.1.3: Minimum steel: with the 4/3 increase over the steel the analysis asks for, the minimum drops (A_s,min,eff) and the face complies even below A_s,min.
en.note_9.3.3.1: Tension-controlled section: the tension steel is past the maximum and the section is no longer tension-controlled, which the article requires.
en.note_7.3.3.1: Tension-controlled section (one-way slab): the tension steel is past the maximum and the section is no longer tension-controlled, which the article requires.
